Rev B | 04 OCT 2026 | Vendor pinouts + proposed Hux circuits
See docs/wiring-atlas.md and the wire register for sources and open circuit decisions.
Use the left / right GPIO table below.
CS → GP26 / GP27 via protection TBD
VREF network TBD: set + measure 2.5 A peak
Four input channels for both wheels
Use a translator suitable for push-pull
No direct 5 V signals into Pico GPIO.
EN low = brake. SLEEP low = outputs off / coast.
2.5 A peak / 1.2 A RMS are Hux qualification targets, not tested settings.
